Polymarket Historical Data
	

V2 contains typed event and observation products for backtesting. Rust acquisition records original public messages continuously; publication is designed for UTC hourly releases. The release manifest reports actual product states and limitations. This build is still under validation and does not establish complete upstream coverage.
